items.claim: Canceled controlled changes still clear errors and validate
items.consequence: A controlled wrapper that updates its value in onValueChange and then calls details.cancel() still triggers the prop-change effect. That effect clears server errors and calls validation.change, so consumers cannot cancel Base UI's internal handling of a controlled keystroke. Carry the cancellation state to the corresponding prop echo and skip those internal effects.
items.proposed_fix: Track cancellation for the controlled onChange echo and skip its internal clearErrors and validation work, while keeping dirty and filled synchronized with the accepted controlled prop.

items.claim: Unmounting a focused control still leaves the field marked focused
items.consequence: The PR description says a control that unmounts or becomes disabled while focused no longer leaves data-focused set, but this effect only sets focus on autofocus and has no cleanup. If the focused control unmounts while Field.Root remains mounted, no blur handler runs and the root and its related parts stay marked focused.
items.proposed_fix: Clear focused state from an effect cleanup and when the control becomes disabled, guarding cleanup so the field does not remain focused after the control leaves the page.

native_payload.intent: Sync controlled Field.Control value changes with dirty, filled, and validation state, while avoiding duplicate validation of user edits. Also honor canceled changes and clear stale focus state when a control unmounts or becomes disabled.
